title: new02; found by us, still unfixed
live_proof: inspection with line numbers in the 3.22.0 tree, and the case is still unfixed upstream: jsonEachColumn()'s default arm returns p->zRoot as SQLITE_STATIC at ext/misc/json1.c:2139, while jsonEachFilter() allocates it at :2244 and jsonEachCursorReset() frees it at :1963. The 3.45.2 fix (28001204f4) converted only the JEACH_JSON arm to SQLITE_TRANSIENT and left this sibling arm as it was
object: p->zRoot, the cursor's own malloc'd copy of the path argument, handed out as SQLITE_STATIC
lifetime_ender: re-filtering the cursor per outer row calls jsonEachCursorReset, which frees the previous zRoot while an accumulator still holds the pointer
fidelity: real consumer, real allocator. Found by us rather than collected: it is the sibling the upstream fix left behind, which is why its upstream_fix is 'unfixed' and not a commit. Same shape and same reduction as case 18; the two differ only in which column of json_each is read

fault_sites_why: The min()/max() accumulator keeps the SQLITE_STATIC zRoot pointer and compares against it after jsonEachCursorReset freed it; the comparison is binCollFunc (consumer), whose byte compare is memcmp. Weaker than a single function: any memcmp under this case would count.
